mapper.sql: om.sys_id AS consumer_session_id, om.link_sys_id AS table_sys_id, om.sys_plant_cd, ( SELECT sp.store_nm FROM sys_plant sp WHERE sp.plant_cd = om.sys_plant_cd AND sp.use_yn = 'Y' AND sp.delete_yn = 'N' ) AS store_name, om.order_status, om.insert_datetime AS started_at, COALESCE(om.modify_datetime, om.insert_datetime) AS last_activity_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_group og WHERE og.link_sys_id = om.sys_id ) AS has_orders, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_group og WHERE og.link_sys_id = om.sys_id ) AND COALESCE(om.modify_datetime, om.insert_datetime) < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AS expired, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM table_info ti WHERE ti.sys_id = om.link_sys_id AND ti.sys_plant_cd = om.sys_plant_cd AND ti.use_yn = 'Y' ) AS table_active
mapper.select: SELECT sys_id FROM table_info WHERE sys_id = #{tableSysId} AND sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND delete_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE
SELECT store_nm FROM sys_plant WHERE plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT
FROM order_master om WHERE om.link_sys_id = #{tableSysId} AND om.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} AND om.insert_user_id = 'CONSUMER' AND om.order_status = '01' ORDER BY om.insert_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_master ( sys_id, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd, order_status, link_sys_id, payment_type ) VALUES ( #{consumerSessionId}, 'CONSUMER', NOW(), #{sysPlantCd}, '01', #{tableSysId}, 'NONE' )
